Architecture note: The billing system is designed to layer on top of existing event tracking without restructuring. Each ad_event already has a click_id for attribution. When billing activates, the nightly rollup job will compute billable totals per campaign per day, report to Stripe as usage records, and the revenue dashboard will query Stripe's billing API. No existing data or processes need to change.
